run_sdf_narrowphase: run the sdf_narrowphase function to compute collision contacts between SDF and other geometry types using warp kernels
test_gradient_descent: test the gradient_descent function that finds minimum distance and contact normal between two geometries via gradient descent
review_sdf_sdf_grad: review the sdf and sdf_grad functions that evaluate signed distance and compute gradients for primitive and volume SDF types
